text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day before training,
as I was heading out to the track—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa.
choice_data_list: Sky? The course is the other way!
Sky? The course is the other way, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah.
I was just thinking of grabbing a drink or something~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...For some reason, those words felt hollow.
Could this be—
choice_data_list: Were you trying to slack off just now?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, not at all!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Maybe there is~, maybe there isn't~,
actually, there totally is!☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ehe☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please~!
Let's take today off, pleaaase~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Because the weather is so wonderful! Come on now, lift your head up and see!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, the sunlight today is warm
and feels wonderful...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Sunlight might all look the same,
but no two days are truly alike."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Pouring light is a once-in-a-lifetime encounter. Sunny days may be plentiful,
but this specific sunshine can only be enjoyed right now.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well? Do you understand
the importance of taking a rest now?
choice_data_list: If you're so desperate to take a break...
If you're so desperate to take a break...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Aw, and here I went through the trouble of dressing up all atmospheric!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But you know, it feels like something good might happen if I rest~ or maybe not~ or maybe definitely not?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way we can train properly like this.
On the other hand, forcing her along might hurt her motivation, but..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This is—
choice_data_list: I'll take you with me even if I have to force you.
Let them rest until they're satisfied.
I'll rest up a bit before training.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ehhhhhhh!
choice_data_list: Let's run and feel the sunlight!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No nooo!
Sei-chan wants to sleep on the soft, fluffy turf!
choice_data_list: Even collapsing onto the turf after giving it your all feels amazing!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, guess I can't push my way through anymore.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: —...Uryaaaaaah~!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... Well, because...
That's what you said, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Collapsing onto the turf after giving it your all is the best feeling," right?
So, run lots and lots—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Poof!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna sprawl right out on the ground!
...Ahhh, yep, this really does feel amazing~♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Listening to what Trainer says every now and then
might not be so bad~..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what are you just standing there for?
Trainer, come join in too!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nobody's looking right now.
...So let's sneak away, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And so, accompanying Seiun Sky after her hard work, I spent some time feeling the breeze out on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Run away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I hurriedly chased after Seiun Sky,
she had fled to—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, maaaaa'am!!
One "Whole-Loaf Menchi Bread," pleeeease!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: —Right about now is when the immensely popular 1kg "Loaf-Sized Menchi Katsu Bread" finishes baking.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"All I have to do is blend into the crowd of Umamusume seeking it, and Trainer won't be able to cut through the pack.
And then... it's my win! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, they'll pull off a wire-to-wire victory...!
Right then, a strategy suddenly came to mind.
And that was—"
choice_data_list: Seiun Sky says she doesn't want the 'one-loaf menchi bread'!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You don't want it...!?
Then give it to meeeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Using the pack to her advantage...?! Urgh,
I don't have the power to withstand them...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Meaning what we should look for right now is an exit.
While everyone's in a panic—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
!? I was already in enemy territory...!
What do I do, what do I do—!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*...
Ugh, Trainer, you sneaky tactician~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I managed to catch Seiun Sky safely, but...
Her mood ended up taking a dip.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Really!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "No, even I think it's a pretty cheeky reason, but..."
choice_data_list: Why don't you take a complete, proper rest for once?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!
Trainer, how generous!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Then as a thank you,
I'll let you in on my secret relaxation spot♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da♪
This is Sei-chan's top secret
relaxation spot!
choice_data_list: It totally looks like a Trainer's office, though.
It totally looks like a Trainer's office, though.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, I used to drop by here pretty often
even before you came along, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's not noisy, it's calming.
Basically the ultimate sleeping spot!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...You don't really seem
all that convinced, though.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I think what I'm saying
is actually pretty incredible, though~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, that's just how it is, yes.
Good niiight."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, I gently moved the sofa so the sunlight would shine down on Seiun Sky as she slept peacefully.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Here, and~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Here, and~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And here, and here,
here, here, and here—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: And here, as well as—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Really? Well then, let's just relax
here for the day.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, as for next time...
I don't know where she'll have run off to, though.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
There might be some hidden in other places
besides the ones I showed you~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Like I'd ever just tell you my real secret
chill spot! You'd come looking for me in a heartbeat.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Still, if we introduce a whole bunch like this,
they'll have no choice but to search everywhere, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Do your best to find me, okay?
I'll be waiting☆ Just kidding!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Evidently, Seiun Sky fully intends to keep slacking off from now on too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wait, so I can rest first?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I might just sweet-talk my way into smoothly slacking off, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh.
choice_data_list: Sky wouldn't slack off after making it this far.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Somehow, when you put it like that,
it just makes me want to do the exact opposite."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it feels kinda bad to betray someone
who innocently believed in you, you know~?”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So with that, shall we stick to the plan?
Let's go, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And so, with plenty of breaks in between, Seiun Sky put in a decent amount of effort into her training.
